> **A common thread runs through all four:** when everyone has access to the same AI, the generic output it produces is the baseline, not the advantage. What lasts is **human judgement**: knowing where AI genuinely helps, where it quietly fails, and where your thinking must stay in charge.

**AI in Delivery** is one of four one-day AI masterclasses in Curtin University's Executive Education program. Each stands completely on its own; together they cover the full arc of working with AI in an organisation: **using** it well, deciding **where to invest**, **delivering** projects that ship, and governing it **ethically**.

::: {.callout-note}
All four are searchable, with dates and enrolment, on the [Curtin Executive Education masterclasses page](https://www.curtin.edu.au/study/professional-development/executive-education/masterclasses/).
:::

## How they fit together

Each masterclass is a complete, standalone day. But they're designed to complement one another:

- **AI in Practice** builds the individual fluency the others assume.
- **AI in Strategy** decides *which* AI initiatives deserve investment.
- **AI in Delivery** (this course) takes a funded initiative and *ships* it.
- **Ethics of Artificial Intelligence** runs *across* all of them: the governance, risk and responsibility lens every AI initiative needs.
